description.value: A family-owned motel situated directly on the historic Route 97 (Cariboo Highway) in the heart of 100 Mile House, the Imperial Motel explicitly welcomes cyclists and motorcyclists alongside business and family travellers. Rooms include a refrigerator, microwave, and air conditioning, with kitchenette units available for longer stays. It sits within walking distance of virtually all town shopping and dining, including the South Cariboo Visitor Centre and Waterfowl Reserve Lake.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms a real, operating motel on Route 97 (Cariboo Highway) in 100 Mile House. The site explicitly names cyclists as a target demographic ('RVers, cyclists, motorcyclists') and confirms free Wi-Fi (corroborating OSM internet_access=wlan) and on-site parking, but makes no mention of secure bike storage, laundry, or other cyclist-specific amenities. The email on the website (contact@imperialmotel100.com) differs from the OSM tag (imperialmotel100@gmail.com), flagged as a concern.
concerns: Email mismatch: OSM lists imperialmotel100@gmail.com, but the website displays contact@imperialmotel100.com as the primary contact email. The website value is likely more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating, publicly accessible motel on a major touring route that explicitly welcomes cyclists. Clear grounds for inclusion.
